‘We’re very confident in Treasury’s forecasts’: Labor defends policy against cooling market

Labor is under pressure to defend itself as new data shows house prices in Sydney and Melbourne recorded their biggest one-month decline in values in three years.

You’ve got to wait more than a few weeks. As I said, there’s a lot happening in the economy and the housing market – much of it as a result of global factors, as we’ve seen now for a few years. I’m very confident that Treasury’ forecasts are well-based, they’ve thought about it very carefully. The history of house prices in Australia is one of growth. And it doesn’t mean there won’t be a week here or a week there that you get particular numbers. But we’re very confident in Treasury’ forecasts.
